body:
Source Pathfinder #102: Breaking the Bones of Hell pg. 13, Pathfinder #2: The Skinsaw Murders pg. 47, Rise of the Runelords Anniversary Edition pg. 422
Aura moderate enchantment [evil]; CL 7th
Slot head; Price 12,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
The wearer of a reaper’s mask gains a +2 competence bonus on Perception checks made against creatures that aren’t immune to fear and a +1 profane bonus on damage with slashing weapons made against living creatures. The wearer can cast confusion twice per day (DC 16). When a reaper’s mask is donned, the wearer takes 1 point of Charisma damage—most Skinsaw cultists don their masks well in advance of a mission so they have time to recover.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, confusion, deathwatch; Cost 6,000 gp
